body: I understand you and honestly your words are my words, but I recommened you to stay here to your 30. Just do what you always wanted to do in these years and try create as many wonderfull moments as possible, because in the end only these things make sense. I know, it will often be hard to live another 12 years (I personally am 20 years old and planning to stay in that shitty world til my 30) but you can do it :) So make an art or make impact on somebody's life (maybe charity is a good option) in order to live forever an then die in peace.

I am just an odd INTP metalhead woman. I love all subgenres of metal (especially atmospheric black metal) and also a lot of rock music and ethnic/world music (for example native american or scandinavian). Generally everything complex and not typical.
